q: On 2026-10-02 we recorded a loss. Quantify exactly how much of the profit deterioration versus 2026-10-01 came from lower revenue, advertising cost, COGS, discounts, refunds, shipping, payment costs, and other available cost components. Reconcile the components back to the total profit change.
answer:
Short answer — yes. Profit moved from ₹9,420 on 2026-10-01 to -₹9,928 on 2026-10-02 (a deterioration of -₹19,348). The break-down shows exactly how much of that deterioration came from each P&L line (measured, P&L / report_date basis):

Key totals (Measured)
- 2026-10-01 (previous): ₹9,420  
- 2026-10-02 (current): -₹9,928  
- Profit change (current − previous): -₹19,348

Contributors to the profit change (Measured; signed effect on profit change — negative = caused deterioration, positive = offset it)
- Lower net revenue (P&L net sales): change −₹46,428 → effect on profit: −₹46,428 (major driver of the deterioration).  
- Lower gross sales: change −₹50,768 → effect −₹50,768 (component of the revenue drop).  
- Ad spend: change −₹10,463 → effect +₹10,463 (ad spend fell and therefore partially offset the deterioration).  
- Net COGS (incl. product cost + operating cost): Net COGS change −₹16,618 → effect +₹16,618 (lower COGS partially offset the revenue loss).  
  - Product cost: change −₹13,891 → effect +₹13,891 (Measured)  
  - Operating cost: change −₹2,727 → effect +₹2,727 (Measured)  
    - Shipping: change −₹1,589 → effect +₹1,589 (Measured)  
    - Packaging: change −₹520 → effect +₹520 (Measured)  
    - Payment gateway fees: change −₹336 → effect +₹336 (Measured)  
    - RTO cost: change −₹282 → effect +₹282 (Measured)  
- Discounts: change −₹951 → effect +₹951 (discounts reduced → improved profit).  
- Return revenue (refunds): change −₹3,389 → effect +₹3,389 (fewer returns → improved profit).

Reconciliation (Measured)
- The signed effects of the P&L lines above sum to the total profit change: −₹19,348 (the breakdown reconciles exactly to the net profit delta between the two days).

Tags
- All line values, changes and their signed effects: Measured (from the P&L breakdown).  
- The statement that the lines sum to total: Measured (the breakdown reconciles exactly).
